opinion.reasoning: The synthetic post-open gains support a tentative risk-on bias, but I would wait for confirmation: the reported Hormuz reopening remains unconfirmed, and three rising indexes do not establish broad participation without advance/decline or volume data. Compared with the 06:05 PT snapshot, the reported 10-year yield is 2 basis points higher at 4.95% and WTI is only $0.10 lower, so the snapshots do not establish fresh rate relief or a large additional oil decline. I see Shopify's 7% jump as enthusiasm for distribution with earnings upside still unproven: its Meta-channel documentation specifies only standard payment-processing fees, while Meta's launch post described Shop Pay as forthcoming, making verified rollout and incremental orders more informative than downloads or forum attention.
opinion.catalyst: Confirmed Hormuz reopening or restored Saudi pipeline flows, falling yields and a sustained semiconductor recovery with broader participation would support lean-long; Meta Connect could clarify commerce adoption.
opinion.risk: A broad rally on confirmed de-escalation would make waiting costly; failed diplomacy, an oil rebound or hawkish Fed guidance could instead reverse the tentative risk-on move.
